_about: Every piece of text in the Goods app, website, Telegram bot and notifications, grouped by page. Fill in the empty "am" field of every string. Do not change keys, "en" or "context". Send the file back as JSON with the same structure.

style_guide.audience: Ethiopian sellers who run shops on Telegram (often on a phone, often Amharic-first), and their buyers. Sellers are small business owners, not tech people.
style_guide.voice: Professional, warm, plain Amharic as used by trusted Ethiopian apps and banks (for example telebirr, CBE Birr). Not literal word-for-word translation: write what a native Amharic product writer would write for this exact screen.
style_guide.formality: Address the user politely and consistently (the respectful form, e.g. ያስገቡ, ይጫኑ, ይዘዙ). Never mix polite and informal forms.
style_guide.buttons_and_labels: Buttons say exactly what happens (verb first where natural). Keep labels short; respect the 'limit' field where present.
style_guide.placeholders: Keep every {placeholder} exactly as written (same braces, same name), but move it to wherever Amharic grammar needs it. Example: '{n} orders to deliver' may become '{n} የሚደርሱ ትዕዛዞች'.
style_guide.markup: Keep HTML tags such as … and …, emoji, and line breaks. Translate the text inside tags.
style_guide.plurals: Keys ending in _one / _other are singular / plural versions. Amharic may use the same wording for both; that is fine.
style_guide.numbers_money: Numbers stay in Western digits (1,500), not Ge'ez numerals. Prices appear as 'ETB 1,500' in the English UI; tell us in the glossary whether Amharic screens should show 'ETB 1,500' or '1,500 ብር'.
style_guide.brand_names: 'Goods' is the product name: never translate it. Keep 'Telegram', 'telebirr', 'CBE Birr', 'Chapa' as brand names (Telegram may be written ቴሌግራም). '@usernames', web addresses and examples like 'abel-phones' stay unchanged.
style_guide.examples: Example values (placeholders inside empty fields such as 'Abel Phones' or 'Bole, near Edna Mall') should become natural Ethiopian examples in Amharic.
style_guide.drafts: Some strings have an 'am_draft' (an earlier machine-quality draft). Treat it only as a hint; replace it if a better phrasing exists.
